phase_name: Repository-Wide Mutation Permission Coverage Contract Independent Verification
summary: Independently verified RWMPC-001 v1.0 (frozen by Phase 149C) rather than trusting 149C's own summary. Re-read RWMPC-001, PBPC-001, PBPA-001, and permission_broker_foundation.py in full; independently re-grepped push.py/agent.py/task.py/phase.py (plus a repo-wide sweep of the rest of src/pcae/) and reconfirmed the same 13 mutation sites, no more, no fewer. Ran the live, unmodified PermissionBroker against hand-built PermissionBrokerRequest instances for every in-scope class: commit/push/promotion-apply resolve ALLOW; rollback resolves HUMAN_REVIEW via POL-004 with approval_present=False (truthful, no trusted evidence source exists) and would resolve ALLOW if approval_present=True existed, isolating the gap to evidence availability alone; simulation_only=False unconditionally triggers POL-005 DENY for every class tested (Foundation-wide, not push-specific). Independently reproduced 149C's 8/2/3 satisfiability classification. One non-blocking clarification finding: build_rollback_execution (AG5) is a separate, explicitly-invoked standalone command (pcae rollback --per-id), not an automatic promotion-failure restore as RWMPC-001's own prose describes -- strengthens rather than weakens the partial-mutation analysis, since no automatic mid-failure rollback exists. Verdict: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS -- RWMPC-001 v1.0 CONFORMS. Implementation-planning readiness: PARTIALLY READY (8 of 13 EXECUTION_CLASS_MUTATION sites ready; rollback coverage (AG3, AG5) blocked on approval-evidence architecture, not on any contract defect; pcae task finish deferral (TK1-TK3) CONDITIONALLY_JUSTIFIED). See docs/PHASE_149D_REPOSITORY_WIDE_MUTATION_PERMISSION_COVERAGE_CONTRACT_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md and tests/test_phase_149d_rwmpc_contract_independent_verification.py.
tests_added_or_updated: Added tests/test_phase_149d_rwmpc_contract_independent_verification.py: 27 independent adversarial tests (mutation inventory reconfirmation, live Foundation satisfiability probes, POL-004/POL-005 controls, approval-evidence-not-self-declared checks, no-caller-policy-selection checks, PBPC/PBPA-unamended checks, no-production-modification checks). No src/pcae/** production code changed, so no production test suite regression risk.

validation_results.name: mutation_inventory_independent_reconstruction
validation_results.result: Directly re-read push.py/agent.py/task.py/phase.py and re-ran the exact git-subprocess grep patterns rather than trusting Phase 149C's table; independently reconfirmed the same 13 real, CLI-reachable mutation dispatch sites. A repo-wide sweep of the rest of src/pcae/ found zero additional git-mutation or non-.pcae/** filesystem-write sites, confirming the four-file scope is not under-inclusive.

validation_results.name: ag5_standalone_command_clarification
validation_results.result: Independently found that build_rollback_execution (AG5) is a separate, explicitly-invoked, standalone CLI command (pcae rollback --per-id, src/pcae/commands/agent.py:16259, wired at cli.py:3055), not an automatic promotion-failure restore as RWMPC-001 Section 4's prose describes. Does not change AG5's classification or disposition; strengthens the contract's partial-mutation/recovery analysis since no automatic rollback is ever attempted mid-failure. Non-blocking, recorded as a documentation-only future clarification.

validation_results.name: task_finish_deferral_independent_verdict
validation_results.result: Independently inspected TK1/TK2 (task.py:260-320) and TK3 (task.py:1070-1103): all three commit pathspecs are mechanically restricted to task-lifecycle-owned closure/destination files, not caller-selectable. Classified the LIFECYCLE_INTERNAL/DEFERRED_COVERAGE disposition as CONDITIONALLY_JUSTIFIED (re-affirmable at implementation time per RWMPC-REQ-054 item 1), not unconditionally JUSTIFIED.

validation_results.name: live_foundation_satisfiability_probes
validation_results.result: Executed the real, unmodified PermissionBroker().evaluate() (not simulated) against hand-built PermissionBrokerRequest instances: commit/push-alternate/promotion-apply (execution_class=mutation, approval_present=False, simulation_only=True) all resolve ALLOW; rollback (execution_class=rollback, approval_present=False, simulation_only=True) resolves HUMAN_REVIEW via POL-004; rollback with hypothetical approval_present=True resolves ALLOW, isolating the gap to evidence availability alone; simulation_only=False resolves DENY via POL-005 for both mutation and rollback classes; commit with no task_id resolves DENY via POL-001. Every result matches RWMPC-001's own claims, independently reproduced rather than accepted.

validation_results.name: simulation_only_semantics_independent_determination
validation_results.result: Independently re-derived simulation_only's meaning from the dataclass docstring and ExecutionDisabledRule.evaluate() directly: a statement about whether the Foundation's own execution boundary (COMP-002, not_implemented) is asked to carry out the action, not a caller promise about mutation intent. Confirmed truthful and contract-compatible for uniform simulation_only=True across all 13 sites.

validation_results.name: action_execution_class_mapping_independent_reverification
validation_results.result: Independently re-verified commit/rollback/promotion-apply/push action_type and execution_class mappings by reading the corresponding functions directly. No mapping was found to be chosen merely to obtain a favorable policy outcome; rollback correctly keeps the stricter EXECUTION_CLASS_ROLLBACK despite it being currently unsatisfiable.

validation_results.name: approval_evidence_trust_model_independent_reverification
validation_results.result: Independently classified every legacy approval-shaped flag (--promotion-authorized, --reviewed-by, approve_rollback, change_approval_state, --approve-keep/--approved-by/--reason, task-finish health/check pass) as non-trusted; confirmed no existing repository artifact constitutes trusted, authenticated approval_present=True evidence for AG3/AG5.

validation_results.name: pol004_applicability_independent_reconfirmation
validation_results.result: Read MissingHumanApprovalRule.applicable_execution_classes directly from source: frozenset({shell, backend, adapter, rollback}); MUTATION and NONE excluded, matching PBPA-001 exactly.
